name: CourtPitchBookingBoard
tagline: Court and pitch hire for sports venues – tariffs, floodlights, block bookings and closures in one drop-in app.
description: A complete facility booking module for tennis and padel clubs, leisure centres and 3G pitch operators: day grid by court with drag-to-move, weekly utilisation heat map, list with bulk actions, peak/off-peak and floodlight pricing, member discounts, recurring block bookings and maintenance closures.
features: Peak/off-peak tariff with lighting surcharge and member discount
Unlit courts blocked after the lighting hour
Weekly block bookings with clash skipping
Maintenance closures that cancel affected bookings
Bulk confirm, mark paid, cancel and CSV export
Undo, demo mode, phone agenda view
